mapper.sql: r.role_seq, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.description, r.org_scope, r.default_data_scope, r.restriction_summary, r.sort_order, r.use_yn, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_by, r.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rp.perm_seq) FROM tb_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_seq = r.role_seq) AS perm_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_policy pol WHERE pol.role_seq = r.role_seq AND pol.use_yn = 'Y') AS policy_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user_role ur JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_seq = ur.user_seq AND u.status <> 'RETIRED' WHERE ur.role_seq = r.role_seq) AS user_count

where.if: AND ( LOWER(r.role_id) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(r.role_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(r.description) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(r.restriction_summary, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_role SET role_name = #{roleName}, description = #{description}, org_scope = #{orgScope}, default_data_scope = #{defaultDataScope}, restriction_summary = #{restrictionSummary}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_yn = #{useYn}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE role_seq = #{roleSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user_role ur JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_seq = ur.user_seq WHERE ur.role_seq = #{roleSeq} AND u.status <> 'RETIRED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_policy WHERE role_seq = #{roleSeq}

SELECT u.user_name FROM tb_user_role ur JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_seq = ur.user_seq WHERE ur.role_seq = #{roleSeq} AND u.status <> 'RETIRED' ORDER BY u.user_name

SELECT u.user_name FROM tb_user_role ur JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_seq = ur.user_seq JOIN tb_org o ON o.org_seq = u.org_seq WHERE ur.role_seq = #{roleSeq} AND u.status <> 'RETIRED' AND o.org_type <> #{orgScope} ORDER BY u.user_name
